titleText: JTF News: CBC News, BBC News
mainText: Violence reported in an Australian town following the arrest of a man in connection with a girl's death.
A man was charged with attempted murder following stabbings of Jewish men in London.
Prosecutors released video of an armed man at a correspondents' dinner.
Brazil's Congress overrides President Lula's veto to reduce former President Bolsonaro's prison sentence.
Iran's supreme leader stated a commitment to protect nuclear and missile capabilities.
